title: Are these safe for cats?
technique: Eight new keyframes (free GPT Image stills) set every beat; Seedance fills the motion between them. The High flip clip lends only its camera move.
story: A cat lady sits on her sofa at night; candles burn all over her apartment, her cat beside her.
She scrolls the Fig & Cedar page up and down, searching. She never buys.
Inner voice, lips closed, the camera circling her: Are these safe for cats?
She finds nothing, gets annoyed, closes the site: I guess we'll never know.
High flip to the owner: I guess no one's interested in Fig and Cedar. No one wants this. Time to discontinue the product line. She blows out the candle.
Scout: Don't guess why your shoppers don't buy. End screen: Scout interviews your shoppers for you. Get free early access.
